description: 協助中油公司高雄煉油廠關廠後土地之利用規劃摘要 [fuel stations and oil] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部. 中油公司高雄煉油廠已於104年底全部停產，其中部分輸儲設施是中油公司南部的油品輸儲樞紐，為穩定供應南部地區油料，避免斷油風險，及進行土壤污染整治需要，擬暫時保留30座油槽、6座污油槽、6座水槽，拆遷期限規劃如資料集。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
